name: geometry-axiom-dev
description: Dependency-free launcher for the existing C bridge and Python web UI

scripts.build: mkdir -p .build && gcc -std=c11 -O2 current_geometry.c -lm -o .build/core && gcc -std=c11 -O2 geometry-web/web_bridge.c -lm -o .build/web_bridge && gcc -std=c11 -O2 geometry-core/model_base.c -lm -o .build/model_base
